name: Lashkar Gah

queries.query: site:gov.af Lashkar Gah cadastral map land registry Afghanistan official
queries.result: First-party discovery found Afghanistan's national portal listing Helmand/Lashkar Gah provincial offices and service points, and an official Ministry of Urban Development and Housing report describing the Helmand urbanism-and-land office and detailed planning for Lashkar Gah. No public parcel-vector viewer or downloadable city parcel layer was found.

officialSources.observation: The Ministry's land-affairs page assigns the General Directorate of Geodesy, Cadastre and Deeds cadastral surveying, deeds, land-information registration, and urban informal-area registration functions.

Official reporting records Helmand provincial requests concerning the Helmand urbanism-and-land office and detailed plans for Lashkar Gah; this is a local administrative lead, not proof of an open parcel dataset.

The current Ministry of Justice PRMIS/PMS page identifies a Property Registration Management Information System. Its shipped JavaScript config uses a relative /api base and the property workflow is gated by authentication/geolocation.
The national portal lists Helmand with Lashkar Gah as its provincial center and provincial offices/service points, but the retrieved page did not expose a cadastral parcel API.
